name: Words referring to women and females
description: Fires on tokens naming women or females (women, woman, female, transwomen), including the repeated noun in 'transwomen are women'.

name: Figuratively versus literally qualifiers
description: Activates on parenthetical or hedging qualifiers contrasting figurative and literal meaning, as in 'Nailed it (figuratively, not literally)'.

name: Browser cache and cookie reset instructions
description: Fires on tech-support phrasing about clearing cache, cookies and resetting the browser, alongside German '-ache' words like sprache and cache.

name: Pubic and body hair grooming
description: Activates on tokens about shaving, trimming and pubic or body hair (pubes, shave, pubic, hair, trim), plus playful 'pub' wordplay.

name: Gemstones and jewelry references
description: Fires on precious-stone and jewelry tokens (gemstone, diamond, gem, ruby, rose, precious), including the name Ruby Rose and remarks about jewelry.

name: Sending explicit photos (dick pics)
description: Activates on crude tokens about sending explicit genital photos (dick, pics, send), as in 'Fight dick pics with dick pics'.

name: Hyphenated 'co-' compound words
description: Fires on words with the 'co-' prefix (co-worker, co-op, co-star), where the hyphenated compound token drives activation across varied contexts.

name: The verb 'drag' and related forms
description: Activates on the verb 'drag' and its inflections (drag, drags), as in 'He will drag him on the plane', alongside 'drag race' tokens.

name: 'Too much' time and money phrasing
description: Low-signal feature firing on 'too much X' constructions involving money and time, as in 'Too much money Too much time'.

name: Right versus wrong with pronouns
description: Fires on correctness judgments paired with subject pronouns (he's right, she's right, you're wrong, correct), as in 'You're wrong, she's right'.
